# Harbor Ledger Amendments

Amendments name the clauses they resolve.

## Amendment A1 — Berth identifiers

Resolution: Clause 4.1

Berth ids must use uppercase letters and digits only.

## Amendment A2 — Crash durability

Resolution: Clause 3.2

An entry must be acknowledged only after it is flushed to stable storage.

## Amendment A3 — Audit export timing

Resolution: Clause 7.2

Audit export moves from wave W1 to wave W2.

## Amendment A4 — Clearance

Resolution: Clause 5.3

The clearance between vessels must be measured bow to stern.

## Amendment A5 — Tariff currency

Resolution: Clause 6.2

Every charge must be stated in the port's declared currency.

## Amendment A6 — Retention start

Resolution: Clause 8.1

The retention period must start at the close of the financial year.
